# tenarium_tenant (Data Source)

Looks up a tenant by ID or slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenarium_tenant" "acme" {
  slug = "acme"
}

output "acme_theme" {
  value = jsondecode(data.tenarium_tenant.acme.settings).theme
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Tenant ID. Exactly one of `id` and `slug` is required.
- `slug` (String) Tenant slug. Exactly one of `id` and `slug` is required.

### Read-Only

- `add_ons` (Set of String) Add-on plan IDs.
- `billing_anchor` (String) Billing cycle anchor (RFC 3339); null when unset.
- `features` (Map of Boolean) Tenant feature overrides.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `limits` (Map of Number) Tenant limit overrides.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent tenant ID.
- `plan` (String) Plan ID.
- `plan_revision` (Number) Plan revision the tenant is pinned to; `0` follows the current plan.
- `region` (String) Region; empty when the tenant has none.
- `settings` (String) Settings as a JSON object string; use `jsondecode()`.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status.
- `status_reason` (String) Explanation of the status, if any.
- `version` (Number) Version.
